GRIST_BOOT_KEY.description: Admin boot key. Paste it at /boot on first run to sign in as the install admin and complete Quick setup.

GRIST_DEFAULT_EMAIL.description: Email that claims the admin account on first login. Replace with your own email to sign in with getgrist.com.

GRIST_SESSION_SECRET.description: Long random string that signs login sessions. Generated for you — never change it after first boot or everyone gets signed out.
